title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole to defeat Talor Gooch after both finished 12-under 268, claiming his first LIV Golf title of 2026 and eighth overall at Asiad Country Club in Busan.

items.headline: Stout Leads NCAA Final Round
items.text: Oklahoma State junior Preston Stout leads the NCAA Championship at 11-under after a third-round 65, holding a one-shot advantage entering Monday’s final round and positioned for a Masters invitation.
